results.excerpt: This is the best content optimizer I’ve ever used. I hate writing articles and blog posts. I procrastinate getting started and agonize over every sentence that I write. Hiring writers is expensive and the results are really hit and miss, especially with SEO. So, I have tried to find writing apps that make the ordeal of writing content easier and faster for me. I’ve tried quite a few other writing apps, and I own Writerzen, Closerscopy, and Postpace - all of which have page optimizers. I prefer the page optimizer in NeuronWriter because it is just more complete and provides a better range of NLP keywords. NeuronWriter provides more info and options, and it’s very flexible. It’s very easy to use with its built-in AI writer or I can use one of my other AI writers. I use TopicMojo and Writerzen for the keyword research and sometimes the initial headers outline. I then copy it over to NeuronWriter and use its NLP Terms to flesh out the article and get the SEO score to where I want it. One feature that I like is the ability to add my own NLP terms along with my desired number of usage. It helps when I’m writing about a topic that doesn’t have much competition for the AI to draw keywords from. A second feature that I like is the “Draft” mode. After having selected your header outline, the “Draft” mode separates your headers into individual blocks and actually gives you specific NLP keyword suggestions for just that header. snapshot.ai_overview: NeuronWriter is an AI-powered content optimization and semantic SEO tool that helps users write and structure web pages to outrank competitors on Google. Core Features SERP & Competitor Analysis: Analyzes top-ranking Google search results (up to the top 30) to understand user intent and content structure. NLP & Semantic Optimization: Uses Natural Language Processing to provide a tailored checklist of relevant keywords, terms, and entities to include. Content Scoring: Gives a real-time content score to track optimization progress against top competitors. AI Writing Assistant: Includes templates, paragraph generators, and FAQ builders that utilize unused recommended terms to boost SEO value. Planning & Organization: Offers internal linking suggestions (via Google Search Console integration), content organizers, and team collaboration features. Pricing Plans Gold Plan: Around $69 per month ($57/mo billed annually); includes 10 projects, 75 content analyses, and 45,000 AI credits. Platinum Plan: Around $93 per month ($77/mo billed annually); includes 25 projects, 100 content analyses, and 60,000 AI credits. Note: Lifetime deals are also frequently featured on platforms like AppSumo.
